visible_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"cc-claim-cc18-kinship-zh","status":"conflict","nature":"confirmed_conflict","category":"relationship","severity":"medium","explanation":"草稿称韩素是韩青的姑姑（姑侄关系），但宗谱记载两人是同父同母的亲姐妹，且宗谱规则规定亲姐妹不能互为姑侄，同一对人物的亲属关系无法同时成立。","reasoning":"Q1直接确立韩素与韩青为同父同母的亲姐妹，把两人的亲属关系定为同辈姐妹；Q2是宗谱提供的静态规则，明确同父同母亲姐妹彼此只是姐妹、不能互为姑侄，为排除姑侄关系提供了必要前提。两条证据主体、范围一致，无时间限定冲突，故与草稿的姑侄关系不能共存。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":null,"evidence_anchor":"不能互为姑侄","relation":"timeless_rule"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"cc-chapter-cc18-kinship-zh-Q1","span_id":"cc-span-cc18-kinship-zh-Q1","relation":"contradicts","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["cc-memory-cc18-kinship-zh-Q1"]},{"chapter_id":"cc-chapter-cc18-kinship-zh-Q2","span_id":"cc-span-cc18-kinship-zh-Q2","relation":"context","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["cc-memory-cc18-kinship-zh-Q2"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"cc-span-cc18-kinship-zh-Q1","role":"prior_state"},{"span_id":"cc-span-cc18-kinship-zh-Q2","role":"current_context"}],"suggested_revision":{"before":"韩素是韩青的姑姑。","after":"韩素是韩青同父同母的亲姐妹。"},"available_actions":["edit","apply_suggestion","keep_intentional","false_positive"]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"cc-claim-cc18-kinship-zh","verdict":"reviewed_issue","basis":"宗谱记载二人为同父同母亲姐妹，宗谱规则又规定亲姐妹不能互为姑侄，与草稿的姑侄关系直接冲突，故按 confirmed_conflict 立案。"}]}
